cards.answer: Zaahen is an AD fighter who builds attack damage by damaging champions and can revive at full Determination. He uses empowered attacks, a pull and a dash to fight, dealing mainly physical damage with healing to sustain himself.
cards.counterplay: Disengage as his Determination builds, and avoid clustering for his healing slam.

citations.quote: Name: Zaahen. Official role tags: Fighter.

Zaahen's attacks and abilities against enemy champions grant him stacks of Determination, gaining bonus Attack Damage per stack. When filled with Determination, Zaahen gains increased Attack Damage and can revive.

facts.claim: Zaahen is an AD fighter who builds attack damage by damaging champions and can revive at full Determination.

citations.quote: Zaahen's next basic attack strikes twice, dealing modified physical damage, applying on-hit effects and healing him based on his maximum health.
Zaahen stabs in a direction, damaging enemies hit, then pulls them toward him.
Zaahen dashes to the target location. Upon arrival, he flourishes his glaive to deal physical damage to nearby enemies.
He then slams his glaive, unleashing a shockwave that deals physical damage to nearby enemies and heals himself for a portion of the damage dealt to champions.

facts.claim: He uses empowered attacks, a pull and a dash to fight, dealing mainly physical damage with healing to sustain himself.

cards.priority_reason: Establishes his sustained fighting pattern and revive threat.

cards.answer: Damaging champions with attacks and abilities builds Determination, granting bonus attack damage that increases greatly at full stacks. With his revive available, lethal damage at full stacks triggers resurrection: he heals while invulnerable, untargetable and unable to act, then revives. His stacks decay after he stops damaging champions.
cards.counterplay: Break contact to let Determination decay; reposition during his resurrection.

cards.answer: His ultimate passively grants armor penetration. On activation, he launches to a location and delivers a delayed physical-damage shockwave, healing for each champion hit. He takes reduced damage during the cast and slam sequence; crowd-control immunity during the initial cast changes to displacement immunity during the launch and slam delay.
cards.counterplay: Spread out and leave the slam area; save crowd control for after his protection ends.
